clips.title: The story
paras: The Loch’s waters are held back by the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan. The lake is the largest body of water on Khaz Modan and sustains the surrounding dwarven settlements.

The Loch spans the center of Loch Modan, among the largest inland lakes in the known world. Only Lordamere Lake and Darrowmere Lake in the north rival its size. Its waters support local fishermen and give Thelsamar and nearby hunting lodges a peaceful setting. Aggressive threshadons and freshwater beasts prowl beneath the calm surface, making a swim across perilous.

The Stonewrought Dam keeps The Loch in its tranquil state. This massive dwarven structure crosses the mountain cleft to the north and prevents the lake from flooding into the Wetlands below. Maintaining it is essential to preserving the valley’s ecosystem and keeping Khaz Modan secure.
